title: Update branding tagline and SEO defaults for IQRA COMMUNICATION

requirements.summary: Update centralized branding configuration to include “MOBILE STORE AND REPAIRING CENTER” and ensure header/footer show it wherever they use siteConfig branding.
acceptanceCriteria: The phrase "MOBILE STORE AND REPAIRING CENTER" is present in frontend/src/content/siteConfig.ts as part of the branding content (e.g., in tagline).
The site header shows the updated branding text on desktop and mobile views (including inside the mobile menu).
The site footer shows the updated branding text if it renders tagline/branding from the centralized configuration.

file_operations.description: Update the centralized branding content (preferably siteConfig.tagline) to include the exact phrase “MOBILE STORE AND REPAIRING CENTER”, keeping all user-facing text in English.
Ensure the header renders siteConfig.tagline in both desktop and mobile header contexts (not only inside the mobile menu) so the updated branding text is visible on mobile views as required.

Verify the footer continues to render tagline/branding from siteConfig and that the updated tagline displays correctly when present (no UI component files under frontend/src/components/ui are modified).

requirements.summary: Align SEO defaults so static HTML title/meta description include the updated branding and remove conflicting SEO phrasing.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/index.html <title> includes "IQRA COMMUNICATION" and "MOBILE STORE AND REPAIRING CENTER".
frontend/index.html meta description includes "MOBILE STORE AND REPAIRING CENTER".
No user-facing SEO text references an unrelated business type (e.g., "Professional Business Solutions") if it contradicts the new branding.

file_operations.description: Update the static HTML <title> and meta description to include both “IQRA COMMUNICATION” and “MOBILE STORE AND REPAIRING CENTER”, and remove/replace conflicting phrases such as “Professional Business Solutions”.
Update the default home page usePageMeta title/description strings to align with the new branding/tagline (avoid conflicting business-type wording), while still leveraging siteConfig for consistency.
